aws_agentcore_api: 66 operations rendered; every one inside the previously-reported set.
  *** CACHE DEFECT FIXED THIS SCAN ***: aws_agentcore_api.txt / amazon-bedrock-agentcore_api.txt were PROSE
  SUMMARIES, not operation lists. They omitted Payments, ABTest, BatchEvaluation, Recommendation,
  InvokeBrowser, SearchRegistryRecords, DeleteCapacityProviderSession, IngestData — and so produced a
  false 25-operation "delta" this scan that cost a full investigation. Both files now hold the LITERAL list.
  LESSON: cache literal lists for enumerable API surfaces. Never cache an LLM summary of one.
  Prior art for the false hits: reports 2026-05-18, 2026-05-21, 2026-04-10, 2026-08-07, 2026-08-21.
